description: Implementation of Zigbee I/O context handling functions for reading and writing various data types, including string and byte arrays, with endian conversions and context management.

classes.name: _ZigbeeIOContext
classes.description: Internal data structure for managing Zigbee I/O operations, including current position, end position, and mode.

methods.name: checkEnd
methods.description: Checks if the current position plus size exceeds the end of the payload, sets error if so.

methods.name: canPerformOperation
methods.description: Verifies if the operation (read/write) is permitted based on mode and buffer boundaries.

methods.name: readVal
methods.description: Reads a value of specified size from the context, handling endian conversion.

methods.name: writeVal
methods.description: Writes a value of specified size to the context, handling endian conversion.

methods.name: zigbeeIOInit
methods.description: Initializes a ZigbeeIOContext with payload, length, and mode.

methods.name: zigbeeIODestroy
methods.description: Destroys the ZigbeeIOContext, logs warning if partial read/write occurred.

methods.name: zigbeeIOGetUint8
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit unsigned integer from the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOPutUint8
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit unsigned integer to the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOGetInt8
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit signed integer from the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOPutInt8
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit signed integer to the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOGetString
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed string from the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOGetBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOPutString
methods.description: Writes a length-prefixed string to the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOPutBytes
methods.description: Writes bytes to the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOGetUint16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit unsigned integer from the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOPutUint16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned integer to the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOGetInt16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit signed integer from the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOPutInt16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit signed integer to the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOGetUint32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit unsigned integer from the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOPutUint32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer to the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOGetInt32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit signed integer from the context.

methods.name: zigbeeIOPutInt32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit signed integer to the context.
